issues.issue: The definition offers three alternatives (i), (ii) and (iii) but closes clause (iii) with the phrase 'which, in either case,' a two-item qualifier. It is unclear which of the alternatives the fiduciary-capacity requirement attaches to.

Requirement (v) is that the substitute loan 'comply with each representation and warranty set forth in Section 2.03 hereof,' but Section 2.03 is the remedies provision and the loan-level representations and warranties are set out in Schedule II and Section 2.04. The standard a substitute loan must meet is miscited.

The definition refers to the 'No-Delay Certificates,' a hyphenated form that does not match the defined term 'No Delay Certificates' specified in the Preliminary Statement. The class of certificates to which the excluded interest relates is identified only by an undefined variant.

The definition ends by taking in assignments and conveyances 'related to the GMACM Mortgage Loans,' a term the Agreement does not define; the defined term is 'GMACM Serviced Mortgage Loans.' The reach of the incorporated assignments is left uncertain.

The formula reads 'the Net WAC for Loan Group 1 ... minus (1) the sum of Current Interest ... , (2) multiplied by 12, (3) divided by the Stated Principal Balance,' which subtracts a dollar amount from a percentage rate before the annualization and division steps. The order of operations, and hence the cap on the related certificates' Pass-Through Rate, cannot be derived from the words used.

Clause (b) enumerates named categories and then extends to any 'similar loan under any other applicable state, federal or local law' and to loans 'similarly classified ... using different terminology,' a catch-all with no fixed boundary. Whether a given loan falls within it is a question of degree.

The definition identifies the class 'with the highest priority for payments pursuant to Section 4.01,' but Section 4.01 governs Advances and the payment priorities are set out in Section 4.02. The cross-reference points to a section that contains no priority order.

Clause (d) excludes a member of the immediate family of 'a Person defined clause (b) or (c) above,' omitting the preposition and referring to clauses that describe relationships rather than define Persons. The exclusion's referent is garbled.

The definition is circular and unbounded: an Insurance Policy is 'any insurance policy' relating to a Mortgage Loan 'including any replacement policy or policies for any Insurance Policies.' Which policies of the Mortgagor, Servicer or Trust are captured cannot be told from the text.

The amount is computed from 'the Current Interest for such Class' for every Class of Senior and Mezzanine Certificates, but Current Interest is defined only with respect to Classes of Offered Certificates, which exclude the Class M-8 Certificates. For those classes the two definitions do not mesh.
